name: Custom Logo
description: Replace the default Jellyfin logo with your own.
overview: Replaces the Jellyfin logo in the web client header and splash screen with an image you upload.

versions.changelog: Works with the 12.x web interface. There the logo is an element rather than a CSS background, so the previous rules had no effect on it. Covers the top bar, the navigation drawer and the dashboard, with configurable heights. Removed the splash-screen option: branding CSS is injected after the splash is replaced, so it could never have applied. Build for Jellyfin 12.0.x / 12.1.x.

Works with the 12.x web interface. There the logo is an element rather than a CSS background, so the previous rules had no effect on it. Covers the top bar, the navigation drawer and the dashboard, with configurable heights.
